132
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, April 3, 2018/Chaitra 13, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Finance; Health and Family
Welfare; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power)
Total number of questions — 15
De-Nationalisation of PSBs
*376. SHRI MANAS RANJAN
BHUNIA:  Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is seriously
planning of de-Nationalise the Nationalised
Public Sector Banks (PSBs) of our country,
if so, the details thereof and planning of
Government in this regard;
(b) how the de-Nationalisation would
be beneficial to Government, to the people
and the country as a whole; and
(c) the total liabilities of PSBs as on
date?
Out flow of FPIs from equity and debt
market
*377. SHRI SUKHENDU SEKHAR
RAY: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount invested by Foreign
Porfolio Investors (FPIs) in January, 2018
and the amount pulled out in February, 2018
and the reasons therefor;
(b) the amount invested by FPIs
between September-December, 2017 in debt
market and the amount sold out by FPIs
from January to 10th March, 2018 and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether FPI outflow from equity
and debt market has caused any impact on
our economy; and
(d) if so, the corrective measures adopted
by Government?
Purchase of farm stubble by
NTPC
*378. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that National

133

Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC)
Limited has proposed to buy farm stubble
from the farmers for its power plants;
(b) if so, the details of the quantity of
stubble proposed to be bought and the
amount allocated for the States of Haryana,
Punjab and Uttar Pradesh; and
(c) the estimated power that will be
generated by using stubble as fuel?
Increase in public expenditure on
social sectors
†*379. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of effective steps
have been taken to bring down the non-
performing public expenditure during the
last four years as a result of which the non-
performing expenditure has substantially
come down;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is a record increase in
the public expenditure in social sectors
during the last four years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Poor access to healthcare facilities in
rural areas
*380. SHRI RAM KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether around 600 million people
in the country, mostly in the rural areas,
have little or no access to healthcare facilities
and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government is considering
any mechanism/scheme/plan to train more
health professionals and depute them in
rural areas and, if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether various Government
hospitals in rural areas are facing the
problem of infrastructure to accommodate
critical care patients; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Non-repayment of loans by corporates
*381. SHRI RITABRATA
BANERJEE: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that non-
repayment of loans by some of the
country's biggest corporate houses is the
major factor for the huge accumulation of
Non-Performing Assets (NPAs);
(b) if so, the details of non-repaid loans,
corporate house-wise; and
(c) the measures adopted to get the loans
repaid?
Electrification of villages in the
country
*382. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the number of villages in our country
which have been provided with the facilities
of total electrification and supplied with
Electricity fully during the last three
years;
(b) the number of villages in our country
which are still not getting the electricity
supply, State-wise; and
(c) whether Government is planning to
provide electricity to these villages?
Women covered under MUDRA Y ojana
*383. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:

134
(a) the number of women entrepreneurs
who have availed credit under the Micro
Units Development and Refinance Agency
Limited (MUDRA) Yojana in the country
since its inception, State/UT-wise including
Tamil Nadu;
(b) the total amount earmarked and
disbursed under the said scheme by the
Public Sector Banks/financial institutions
to women communities during the last three
years, bank-wise; and
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to cover more women
entrepreneurs under MUDRA Yojana?
Scam in PNB Branches
†*384. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether another case of fraud
through Letter of Understanding (LoU) in
Brady House Branch of Punjab National
Bank (PNB) has come to light;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) total amou

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, April 3, 2018/Chaitra 13, 1940 (Saka)

(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Finance; Health and Family
Welfare; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power)
Total number of questions — 160
Reservation of seats in Homoeopathy
colleges
4001. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of AYURVEDA,
YOGA & NATUROP A THY , UNANI,
SIDDHA AND HOMOEOPATHY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Homoeopathy
medical colleges set up by Government
during last three years in the country,
State/UT-wise;
(b) how many Homoeopathy medical
colleges out of them are operational at
present in the country, State/UT-wise
including Maharashtra;
(c) whether reservation is given to
reserved category people in these colleges;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Market share of Ayurvedic diabetes
medicines
†4002. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the share of Ayurvedic medicines
among the medicines available in the market
for the treatment of diabetes; and
(b) the number of Ayurvedic companies
having the licences to manufacture and
market the medicines for the treatment of
diabetes and the details thereof?
 Reducing the doctor-patient ratio in
AYUSH systems of medicine
4003. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to reduce the gap between the
number of doctors and patients in the
AYUSH systems of medicine in the
country;
(b) if so, details of the proposal and
present doctors and patients ratio in
AYUSH systems of medicine; and
(c) what are the steps taken by
Government to further reduce the doctors-
patients ratio in AYUSH systems of
medicine and the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

 AYUSH hospital at Visakhapatnam
4004. SHRI V . VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has recently approved a 50-bedded
AYUSH hospital at Visakhapatnam under
National AYUSH Mission;
(b) whether it is also a fact that ` 100
lakh have also been released recently;
(c) if so, the details thereof and how
this meagre amount is sufficient for the
hospital; and
(d) why cannot the Ministry plan to
have AYUSH medical college in
Visakhapatnam as there is also Regional
Ayurveda Research Institute at Vijayawada?
 Ministry's staff strength
4005. DR. VINAY P.
SAHASRABUDDHE: Will the Minister
of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of employees/staff
strength sanctioned for the Ministry's
headquarters in Delhi;
(b) how many of these positions have
been filled in as of January 31, 2018;
(c) what are the problems being faced in
early filling up of the vacancies and action
Ministry is taking in overcoming these
problems; and
(d) the mother tongue-wise break-up of
the employees currently working in the
Ministry's headquarters in Delhi and what
efforts, if any, are being taken to ensure
adequate language diversity?
 Funds for National Institute of
Siddha, Chennai
4006. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government had provided
adequate funds for the National Institute
of Siddha, Chennai for enhancing
infrastructure developments and research
facilities;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's allocation in the last three
years in this regard;
(c) whether Government has provided
all the required R&D facilities for Siddha
doctors to find cure for HIV/AIDS, various
types of Cancer and Diabetes; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof and the
funds allocated for the same?
 Improving the quality of AYUSH
educational institutions
4007. SHRI HARSHVARDHAN
SINGH DUNGARPUR: Will the Minister
of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up undergraduate and postgraduate
AYUSH educational institutions in all
States, particularly in Rajasthan;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken to improve the
quality of AYUSH educational institutions
already in existence?
